evidence.name: data export flow
evidence.details: Privacy page starts a JSON export download and shows success feedback.

evidence.name: rate-limit UX
evidence.details: 429 response from data export endpoint leaves the user on-page with visible error feedback.

evidence.name: data deletion flow
evidence.details: Delete action opens browser confirmation and posts confirm=DELETE to the profile deletion endpoint.

evidence.name: cloud outage UX
evidence.details: Storage health failure displays an error while preserving the settings route.

evidence.name: AI provider failure UX
evidence.details: Provider test failure is surfaced in the AI model settings UI.

evidence.name: auth failure E2E
evidence.details: 401 response from export endpoint leaves the privacy page stable with visible error feedback.
